metadata_json.provider_model_id_source: Google publishes no third-party REST API for Flow, no per-call or per-credit price, and no terms authorising programmatic access. Flow is sold as credits inside Google AI subscriptions. The aisandbox-pa host in FLOW_API_BASE appears only in unofficial write-ups. Checked 2026-08-26.

NARWHAL is NOT a Google-published identifier. It appears on no page of support.google.com/flow, labs.google, blog.google or deepmind.google. Flow's published model names are Veo 3.1 Lite/Fast/Quality, Gemini Omni Flash and Nano Banana. Left as-is because there is no real id to correct it to; the model is unverifiable, not mis-typed. Checked 2026-08-26.
Google's Gemini API publishes veo-3.1-generate-preview (Vertex: veo-3.1-generate-001). veo-3.1-quality is a Google Flow UI label, not an API model id. Read 2026-08-26.
xAI publishes grok-imagine-video and grok-imagine-video-1.5; grok-video appears as no id or alias on docs.x.ai. Read 2026-08-26.

t2v.note: the published HTTP API has no media array and no reference image; audio is one optional custom track at input.audio_url

i2v.note: the provider publishes a closed combination list; reference_image is not among the accepted types at all

r2v.note: reference_voice is an optional audio URL nested inside a reference_image or reference_video entry, never a media entry of its own

wire_contract.note: media.type carries the semantic role verbatim; it is not a media category and it is not inferred from array position. An earlier profile declared the opposite and the adapter posted 'image'/'video'/'audio', which the API rejects.

continuation.reason: continuing from a clip is an I2V operation: the clip is what the new footage grows out of, exactly as a first frame is

voice.reason: R2V takes an audio URL fixing the timbre of the subject in a reference material. It is a field on the reference entry, not a media type. The same flag authorises i2v driving_audio: both are audio the model conditions on, as opposed to supports_audio, which is audio it produces.

edit.reason: Wan 2.7 publishes t2v, i2v and r2v only; this adapter exposes no edit operation and generate_image raises CAPABILITY_NOT_SUPPORTED

driving_audio.reason: audio that drives the performance, carried as its own media entry alongside a first frame or first clip

custom_audio.reason: a custom audio track on the text-only mode; an input field, not a media entry
